notes.title: 2022 New Update! Additional Turkish updates, and more
notes.content:
[h1]Long time no see.
Here's news of the Lynn update for 2022.[/h1]

[h2]1. Add various languages[/h2]

First, the Turkish language was updated in Lynn.
You can now enjoy this game in Turkish.

Despite the many letters and difficult sentences,
I would like to thank the Turkish user who translated it into Turkish.

[h2]2. Modify some language sentences[/h2]

Lynn games had problems with some translated languages.
Some sentences with these translation problems have been corrected.
I would also like to thank the users of various countries for their help.

[h2]3. Fixing bugs[/h2]

There were some bugs in the lean game that prevented the game play.
This bug was harder to fix than I thought.
However, thanks to the efforts of our team's developers, we were able to fix some of these bugs.

Because Lynn was implemented by complex puzzle rules,
There are still some bugs left.
I will update it when I have a chance to fix it later.


[b]I hope we all have good news next time
and I hope Lynn was a good memory for you.[/b]

notes.title: 1st revision update after official release
notes.content:
Hi~ I am DOTORIS 

I updated to a new version yesterday and a bug error occurred. 
We've just fixed this bugs and you can play by updating the game via Steam. 

1. Chapter Open Bug Error

There was a bug that some users could not open or enter the chapter.

The bug was fixed and uploaded on Steam.
So, please update your game on Steam. 
You will be able to play that part smoothly without any problems.

2. Achievement Bug Error

There was a bug where the several steam achievements were not achieved even if all 3 Fox Beads (Stars) were acquired.
The bug has also been fixed.
So, If you have already obtained all 3 Fox Beads (Stars), you can complete the challenge by clearing the 1st stage of each chapter once the data is updated.


Please let me know if you have another problem. 

Hope you enjoy playing Lynn.
